CB.menuHint: Practice locally or, as GM, send a code-matrix challenge to a player.
CB.houseRule: Optional home rule / original matrix puzzle. Not official RED Netrunning.
CB.rules: Start in the top row. Then alternate the last cell's column and row. Each cell can be used once. Fill all target sequences contiguously in your buffer, in any order. The timer starts with your first legal selection.
CB.ready: Ready. Select a cell in the top row to start.
CB.full-buffer: Buffer full. Not all targets matched.
CB.invalidMove: Choose an unused cell on the active row or column.
CB.error: Cipher Breach could not complete this action. Check the console and your chat permissions; retry or ask your GM.
CB.untrusted: UNVERIFIED player report. Legal-move replay checks consistency only, not timing, identity authenticity or honest play. Retries are possible. The GM adjudicates manually; no actor, currency or world data is changed.
CB.closeWarning: Closing this window discards the run. There is no resume or automatic submission.
CB.configHint: Buffer: 4-14 cells. It must fit target count times sequence length. Every generated puzzle has a legal path that completes all targets. Difficulty is an original home-rule choice, not a game formula.
CB.configError: Unable to launch. Check all numeric limits, buffer >= target count times sequence length, and chat permissions. Details are in the console.
CB.challengeCard: Cipher Breach: GM challenge. The assigned participant can open a fresh attempt below.
CB.resultCard: Cipher Breach: unverified player report. A GM may replay its legal moves below.
CB.consistent: The reported moves and outcome are logically consistent with the currently available GM-authored challenge. This is not an authoritative success or proof of elapsed time.
CB.invalidPayload: Invalid or unavailable Cipher Breach data; ask the GM to issue a new challenge.
